subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on BMW engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the S54 across all 2 model applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The S54 appears in two applications — the E46 M3 and Z4 M — both of which we work on regularly.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Rod bearings, timing chain, VANOS components, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: The S54 has well-documented service requirements — rod bearing wear, VANOS failure, and (separately, related to the E46 M3 chassis rather than the engine) subframe cracking. These are genuine considerations for an owner deciding whether to rebuild their S54, and we account for them during a full rebuild.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page - they'll be added once a documented set of completed S54 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.
